title: Customer VAT, Dimension and Payment Method Boundary Decision
businessPurpose: Decide whether U-CUST-100 can move toward O2C route planning with VAT Business Posting Group, dimensions and payment method still explicitly unproven, or whether another read-first/setup case is required first.
decisionQuestions: Can VAT Business Posting Group remain parked before the next read-first O2C route decision?
Can dimension defaults remain parked before the next read-first O2C route decision?
Can payment method remain parked while Payment Terms Code NET30 is proven?
What exact next case gives the best book, training and evidence value without jumping into posting readiness?

nextStepDecision.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: U-CUST-100 customer setup values are now visually proven, but O2C would be premature until VAT, dimension and payment-method boundaries are consciously accepted or split into read-first cases.
